description: This file provides utility functions for currency conversions and formatting, specifically handling USD and credits, including parsing, formatting, and rendering functions for use in a React application.

methods.name: usdToCredits
methods.description: Converts a USD amount to credits based on a shared rate, rounding to the nearest whole credit.

methods.name: parseUsdToNumber
methods.description: Parses a USD-like string or number into a numeric value, returning null if not parseable.

methods.name: formatCredits
methods.description: Formats a numeric credits value with thousands separators and a 'credits' suffix.

methods.name: formatUSD
methods.description: Formats a number or string as USD currency using a shared formatter, with fallback to an em dash.

methods.name: formatUsdWithCredits
methods.description: Formats USD with credits in parentheses, including support for credits display.

methods.name: renderUsdWithCredits
methods.description: Renders USD amount with credits in parentheses, as a React span element with tooltip.
